vetSays.line: A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
A person, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A person, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
A person, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 74/100)

🔥 The fire settles. the person in their 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer — I put it down today." "It rears up, belly swelling drum-taut, and beats it with both paws — BOOM. The air itself flinches." "It waddles left, then is suddenly right — a feint, testing whether your eyes or your ears are in charge." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Soo breathes "So it bleeds." The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village.
